# CAL CST ASCII fixtures (SYNTHETIC_TEST)

Small synthetic whitespace-delimited files in the CST full-sphere far-field ASCII layout
(col1 theta, col2 phi, col3 Realized Gain dBi, cols 4..8 filler). **Not antenna data.**
Generated by `tests/+testutil/CalSynthetic.m` (15° grid, 13 x 24 = 312 rows).

| File | Variant |
|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_TEST_standard_15deg.txt` | CST-style header + `-----` separator, multiple spaces |
| `SYNTHETIC_TEST_tabs_crlf_broken_header_15deg.txt` | truncated header (`Thet`), no separator, tabs / mixed spaces, CRLF |

Further variants (shuffled rows, malformed / duplicate / missing samples, pole noise, phi = 360 alias)
are generated at test time into temporary directories by `tests/test_cal_cst_ingestion.m`.
Real owner CST files are never placed here or in `data/cal` by the tests.
